definitions: The action of introducing something or someone.
A thing that is introduced, such as a new product, system, or idea.
A preliminary part of a book or other work, explaining its purpose and scope.
A book or course that provides a basic grounding in a subject.
The presentation of one person to another or others.
A formal act of placing a bill or motion before a legislative body.
examples: The introduction to the novel was very informative.
The introduction of the bill caused debate.
